prompt: Sticker sheet of 12 separate small vignette scenes of everyday accidents and dangers, cute children's picture-book illustration, soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture with fine dark outlines, warm gentle colors, one consistent style for all items. Each item isolated on plain pure white background, lots of white space between the items, arranged in a clean grid of 4 columns x 3 rows (12 items), no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no paper sheet, no sticker borders, no frames, no shadows, each object complete and fully visible, nothing cut off at the edges.
